label: Amulet of Lathander
Description: This amulet brings back the user from the brink of death. (When HP reaches 0, the amulet casts heal. Does not work if the user dies instantly.)
limitation: The amulet is only wearable by those who revered good. The amulet burns everyone else until removed.

label: Tail of bonefiend
Description: Tale of a bone fiend, with a poisonous spike. (Attack: 1d6 normal damage, 2d4 poison damage. Target must succeed on a DC 14 Cons saving throw or become poisoned)
limitation: Difficult to use: -4 to hit. On a 1 or 2 deals damage to user.
